behaviors_asserted: Custom helper methods defined in Env.Helpers are directly accessible on the Context object.
Helper methods receive the context instance as their this binding and can access context via this.
If options.helpers is provided to the Context constructor, Object.assign(this, options.helpers) is used to attach helpers to the context instance.
HonoOptions includes an optional helpers property typed as E['Helpers'].
The exported Context type is HelperMethods<E> & ContextBase<E, P, I>, so helper methods are included in the Context type for TypeScript typing.
